CustomField.description: Names a button trigger this page listens for, enabling button-driven forward navigation. When a FLOW_BUTTON message arrives whose triggerName matches this value, formTemplate.js treats it as the page's forward action (handleButtonMessage / next-page flow), so a custom button inside a section can advance the form instead of the standard Next button. Primarily used in Flow mode (isFlow) to coordinate a section's own button with page navigation. Text(255). Leave blank to use only the standard navigation buttons.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the trigger name of a button (from a Buttons component on this page) that should move the form forward when clicked, instead of the standard Next button. The name must exactly match the button's trigger; leave it blank if the page should advance only via the normal navigation buttons.
CustomField.label: Trigger Listener Name
